name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
label: Quest
description: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The undead fear life just as the living fear death. It is not unusual for a sentient undead being to completely destroy all remnants of his or her previous life after having turned.
Unfortunately, in order to create an artifact capable of reverting Ras Frostwhisper to a mortal, we must have a keepsake from his years among the living.
You must venture to the ruined city of Stromgarde, Frostwhisper's home, and search for such an item. May luck be with you, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: A keepsake of remembrance is a rare find, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I had doubted the possibility of such an item existing. This certainly opens up an incredible opportunity - one we must not squander.
Prepare yourself, friend, for what I am about to ask of you will take you into the depths of hell.
